artifacts_produced.deploy_evidence: A local tool a seat runs; it prints and reads bus lines and sends nothing. Nothing is deployed.
A local test on temporary directories that it removes; nothing is deployed.
A skill text read by seats: one new section appended at the end; nothing is deployed.

acceptance.criterion_verbatim: python .tools/tests/test_crossbox_call.py expect: CROSSBOX-TEST cases= (every case passing: the line must read ok=True)
acceptance.output_evidence: timeout 120 rc=0, about 24 s wall. LAST line: CROSSBOX-TEST cases=57/57 ok=True. Covers the 21 selftest cases as separate assertions, the inbox file's header fields and filename pattern against org/mcp/server.py _deliver_to_one, the file landing in the directory org/mcp/inbox-watch.sh resolves (its own resolution lines run in Git Bash, the watcher not started), an order for a serial with no agent folder or no inbox refused with 'no such seat on this box', an unknown key and a missing key refused, the command line end to end (exit 0, 3, 5), the two existing readers (crossbox-deploy-check.py, open-calls.py) reading a file this tool wrote, and the SEAT_RULES.json probe for this cell run and matched against its expect regex.

acceptance.criterion_verbatim: python .tools/crossbox-call.py --selftest expect: CROSSBOX-SELFTEST cases= (the exchange between two stand-in boxes, including half-closed and sent-not-acked: the line must read ok=True)
acceptance.output_evidence: timeout 120 rc=0, about 23 s wall. LAST line: CROSSBOX-SELFTEST cases=21/21 ok=True. Two scratch git checkouts stand for two boxes (device names read from the register, two scratch directories removed at the end): uncommitted body refused; own box refused; open, line, sent; status reads 'SENT, NOT ACKED (sent 5 min ago'; receive before the pull reads PULL-FIRST and writes nothing; a line with the id altered and one with the seat altered refused; receive lands one file in the seat's inbox and a second receive does not deliver again; the sending box cannot ack; ack prints the reply line; acked records it; one side closed reads 'HALF-CLOSED (from only)' and the REAL open-calls.py reader refuses the call; merge folds the other box's fields in; both recorded reads CLOSED-BOTH and the real open-calls.py reader accepts it; the sending box reads CLOSED-BOTH after its merge; an unknown key refused.

mutant.description: Difference control: the same call read by the real .tools/open-calls.py reader when only one side is closed and when both are.
mutant.expected: half-closed: no file found (refused); both closed: the file name returned
mutant.observed: selftest cases the-open-calls-close-reader-refuses-a-half-closed-call (None) and the-open-calls-close-reader-accepts-CLOSED-BOTH (the file name) both pass; test case 'a call whose file is not CLOSED-BOTH is not settled' passes

determinism.method: Both criteria were run twice against the same tree (once before the build commit, once for the record).

declared_exclusions.item: a real exchange between two machines over the agent bus
declared_exclusions.reason: BLIND by construction (the order's preflight): this seat sends nothing on the bus and cannot reach another box. The bus is replaced by handing the printed line across in the test; each box runs and reads back its own real exchange.

declared_exclusions.item: the watcher picking up the file
declared_exclusions.reason: the watcher is not started (the order forbids it). The test runs the watcher's own directory-resolution lines in Git Bash and shows the file lands in the directory it reads, with the *.md name pattern its loop globs.
none is created in the real tree: a cross-box file is a record of a real call a CTO opens, and an invented one would read as an open call to .tools/crossbox-deploy-check.py
